items.title: Lazy start
items.summary: Nothing runs at game start; the first command builds the runtime

items: Press Play and nothing happens. The Pipeline listener is native and always on, in the Editor and in dev builds.
A domain reload deletes the static. The next command builds the runtime again, at no extra cost.
Systems find scene objects at call time, not at build time. The root can start in Edit Mode and serve Play Mode.
Commands run on the main thread, so the lazy build has no thread race.
